% ---------- Prohibitions (Art 5 (1)) ----------
prohibited_ai_practice(S) :-
    (places_on_market(_,S) ; putting_into_service(_,S) ; use_of_ai_system(_,S)),
    (deploys_subliminal_technique(S) ; manipulative_or_deceptive_technique(S)),
    materially_distorts_behaviour(S),
    causes_significant_harm(S).

prohibited_ai_practice(S) :-
    (places_on_market(_,S) ; putting_into_service(_,S) ; use_of_ai_system(_,S)),
    exploits_vulnerability(S),
    materially_distorts_behaviour(S),
    causes_significant_harm(S).

prohibited_ai_practice(S) :-
    (places_on_market(_,S) ; putting_into_service(_,S) ; use_of_ai_system(_,S)),
    evaluation_or_classification(S),
    social_score_leads_to_detrimental_treatment(S).

prohibited_ai_practice(S) :-
    (places_on_market(_,S) ; putting_into_service(_,S) ; use_of_ai_system(_,S)),
    makes_risk_assessment(S),
    based_solely_on_profiling(S),
    \+ permitted_risk_assessment_support(S).

prohibited_ai_practice(S) :-
    (places_on_market(_,S) ; putting_into_service(_,S) ; use_of_ai_system(_,S)),
    creates_or_expands_facial_recognition_database(S),
    untargeted_scraping(S).

prohibited_ai_practice(S) :-
    (places_on_market(_,S) ; putting_into_service(_,S) ; use_of_ai_system(_,S)),
    infers_emotions(S),
    context_in_workplace_or_education(S),
    \+ intended_for_medical_or_safety(S).

prohibited_ai_practice(S) :-
    (places_on_market(_,S) ; putting_into_service(_,S) ; use_of_ai_system(_,S)),
    biometric_categorisation_system(S),
    deduces_sensitive_attributes(S),
    \+ lawful_labelling_or_filtering_in_law_enforcement(S).

prohibited_ai_practice(S) :-
    real_time_remote_biometric_identification_system(S),
    law_enforcement_use(S),
    publicly_accessible_space_used(S),
    \+ permitted_use_rtrbis_law_enforcement(S).

% Permission for risk‑assessment support (exception to (d))
permitted_risk_assessment_support(S) :-
    supports_human_assessment(S),
    based_on_objective_and_verifiable_facts(S).

% Permission for real‑time remote biometric ID (exception to (h))
permitted_use_rtrbis_law_enforcement(S) :-
    objective_targeted_search(S).
permitted_use_rtrbis_law_enforcement(S) :-
    objective_prevent_threat(S).
permitted_use_rtrbis_law_enforcement(S) :-
    objective_localise_suspect(S).

% ---------- Procedural requirements (Art 5 (2)–(6)) ----------
% Deployment must be limited to confirming identity of the specifically targeted individual
deployment_purpose_confirm_identity(S) :-
    real_time_remote_biometric_identification_system(S),
    law_enforcement_use(S),
    objective_in_objectives(S).

% Elements to be taken into account
consider_nature_of_situation(S) :-
    real_time_remote_biometric_identification_system(S),
    law_enforcement_use(S).

consider_consequences_for_rights(S) :-
    real_time_remote_biometric_identification_system(S),
    law_enforcement_use(S).

% Authorization condition (unless urgency)
authorization_required(S) :-
    real_time_remote_biometric_identification_system(S),
    law_enforcement_use(S),
    \+ urgent_case(S),
    completed_fundamental_rights_impact_assessment(S),
    registered_in_eu_database(S).

% Urgency exception
registration_allowed_in_urgency(S) :-
    real_time_remote_biometric_identification_system(S),
    law_enforcement_use(S),
    urgent_case(S),
    registration_completed_without_undue_delay(S).

% Notification obligation
notification_obligation(S) :-
    real_time_remote_biometric_identification_system(S),
    law_enforcement_use(S),
    notify_market_surveillance_and_data_protection(S),
    notification_contains_minimum_info(S),
    \+ includes_sensitive_operational_data(S).

% Annual reporting by national authorities
annual_report_submission(Authority) :-
    (market_surveillance_authority(Authority) ; data_protection_authority(Authority)),
    submit_annual_report_to_commission(Authority).

provenance(registration_allowed_in_urgency/1, 'celex:32024R1689/oj#art_5').
provenance(notification_obligation/1, 'celex:32024R1689/oj#art_5').
